name: Media hall of mirrors
doc: The picture on a wall of mirror panes in 3D: each pane reflects its part of the picture and swings on its hinge with the beat (a wave from the left, from the right, petals opening from the centre, a nod from the top, one per beat of the bar), so a tilted pane shows another part of the picture; the bass swings them further, kicks push the panes toward you and twist them, and the glass catches a palette glint and rim.

in.doc: the picture the panes reflect, e.g. core-media.out

palette.doc: glint, rims, tint and the wall behind

gap.doc: space between panes, share of a cell

swing.doc: beat swing in radians (bind a bass follower)

bass.doc: the raw bass widens the swing too

alternate.doc: 1: neighbours swing the opposite way (zig-zag), 0: all together

kick.doc: kick level (bind an envelope): pushes panes toward you and twists them

push.doc: how far a full kick pushes the panes

twist.doc: random tilt a full kick gives each pane, radians

drift.doc: slow idle sway, so a quiet room still moves

depth.doc: how far away the reflected picture is: more = a tilt slides it further

tint.doc: each pane tinted by a palette colour

sheen.doc: palette glint when a pane faces the light

rim.doc: bright bevel on the pane edges
